annotations.title: Get a conference's sponsors and exhibitors

description: Use this when someone asks which companies sponsor or exhibit at a specific conference. Returns company names, websites, role (sponsor, partner, media partner or exhibitor) and sponsorship level for one edition, ordered by how many conferences each company is listed at. Returns up to 50 companies per call with the total count; use offset to read further.

limit.description: Companies to return, default 25, at most 50.

name_or_slug.description: A conference name such as "NAB Show" or "Money20/20", or its conferencedatabase.com slug such as "nab-show". A year in the name is ignored.

offset.description: Companies to skip, to read the next page.

role.description: Only companies with this role. Leave out for all roles.

year.description: Edition year. Leave out for the current or next edition.

name: get_conference_sponsors
title: Get a conference's sponsors and exhibitors
